qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes. Our Oakland Park shop is open 7 days a week, 8 AM to 7 PM, including Sunday. Walk-ins are welcome.

qa.q: Do you work on Tesla and hybrids?
qa.a: Yes. We service Tesla and hybrid vehicles: brakes, suspension, tires, 12V systems, A/C and diagnostics. High-voltage battery work is assessed case by case after diagnosis.

qa.q: Do you repair Ferrari, Lamborghini and other exotics?
qa.a: Yes. We service Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Maserati and Aston Martin with factory-level diagnostic tools, photo inspections and written estimates.

qa.q: What warranty do you offer?
qa.a: Repairs carry a 2-year/24,000-mile warranty. Details are on prestige.tires/warranty.

qa.q: Do you speak Spanish?
qa.a: Sí. Hablamos español en ambos talleres.

qa.q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
qa.a: Yes. The Oakland Park lot is open 24 hours with a key drop box at the front door; we call you in the morning.

qa.q: Do you offer fleet accounts?
